topic.label: Programming Languages
topic.desc: Programming Languages: Python, C and C++, Java and Kotlin, Shell Scripting, TypeScript, Rust and Go.

concepts.label: C and C++
concepts.desc: C and C++ memory management, build systems and systems programming.

concepts.label: Go
concepts.desc: Go modules, goroutines, channels, testing and tooling.

concepts.label: Java and Kotlin
concepts.desc: Java and Kotlin build, dependency, concurrency and testing practice on the JVM.

concepts.label: Python
concepts.desc: Python code, packaging, typing, testing and async work.

concepts.label: Rust
concepts.desc: Rust ownership, lifetimes, cargo, crates and safe interfaces to unsafe code.

concepts.label: Shell Scripting
concepts.desc: Shell scripts that are safe, portable and automatable.

concepts.label: TypeScript
concepts.desc: TypeScript types, compiler settings and Node or browser builds.

skills.label: C Systems Interfaces
skills.desc: Designs header files, ABI-stable interfaces and system-call wrappers and checks portability across platforms.

skills.label: C and C++ Memory and Build
skills.desc: Finds memory errors with sanitizers, applies ownership idioms such as smart pointers and sets up CMake builds.

skills.label: Go Modules and Concurrency
skills.desc: Structures Go modules and writes goroutine and channel code with cancellation, and checks for leaks and races.

skills.label: Go Testing and Tooling
skills.desc: Writes table-driven tests, runs vet and the race detector and wires benchmarks into the build.

skills.label: JVM Build and Dependencies
skills.desc: Configures Gradle or Maven builds, resolves dependency conflicts and packages Java and Kotlin artifacts.

skills.label: JVM Concurrency and Testing
skills.desc: Writes thread-safe Java and Kotlin code with coroutines or executors and tests it with unit and integration tests.

skills.label: Python Async and Data Pipelines
skills.desc: Writes asyncio code and data-processing pipelines, then profiles them and explains where the time goes.

skills.label: Python Environment Manager
skills.desc: Creates virtual environments, pins dependencies in a lock file and writes packaging metadata so a project installs the same way on another machine.

skills.label: Python Typing and Testing
skills.desc: Adds type hints, runs a static type checker and writes pytest tests with fixtures, reporting which behaviour is still untested.

skills.label: Rust Cargo and Crates
skills.desc: Manages Cargo workspaces, features and crate dependencies and runs clippy and tests before release.

skills.label: Rust Ownership and Lifetimes
skills.desc: Explains and fixes borrow-checker errors by redesigning ownership, lifetimes and data structures rather than cloning everything.

skills.label: Rust Unsafe and FFI
skills.desc: Wraps unsafe code and foreign-function interfaces in safe APIs and documents the invariants each unsafe block relies on.

skills.label: Shell Automation Pipelines
skills.desc: Builds command pipelines and scheduled jobs for file, log and deployment tasks and says what each job needs permission to touch.

skills.label: Shell Script Safety
skills.desc: Writes shell scripts with strict error handling and correct quoting and checks them with a linter before they run.

skills.label: TypeScript Node and Web Build
skills.desc: Configures npm scripts, bundlers and module formats for Node services and browser apps and fixes build failures.

skills.label: TypeScript Types and Compiler Config
skills.desc: Sets strict compiler options and designs types, generics and discriminated unions so errors surface at build time.
